name: Damon Runyon Fellowship Award
amount: USD 70,000 / 72,000 / 74,000 / 76,000 stipend (years 1-4) + USD 2,000/year expenses + USD 1,000 per child
other_rules: Basic scientists: degree no more than 18 months old at the deadline and no more than 1 year in the sponsor lab
physician-scientists: residency complete and board eligible, before first faculty post
non-US citizens must work at a US institution
US citizens may go abroad only for exceptional opportunities
notes: Cancer research. Last confirmed deadline 14 Aug 2026 (also a spring round historically); check damonrunyon.org. Years 2-4 depend on progress. A Quantitative Biology Fellowship track also exists.
